name: Windows utilities · Touchscreen helpers
description: Touchscreen utilities for kiosk or field Windows hardware: touch-first UX and hardening considerations for unattended devices.
longDescription: Utilities for touch-first Windows setups such as kiosks or field devices. Kiosk deployments imply a stricter threat model: physical access, shared sessions, and accidental escape from full-screen shells. Scope stays narrow within a larger automation monorepo; full detail is available in the linked source.
features: Touch-first interaction constraints including target sizes and scaling
Kiosk-oriented guidance to minimise escape hatches where required
highlights: Experience beyond traditional keyboard and mouse desktop UX
challenges: Touch targets and display scaling vary per device.
solutions: Test on representative hardware and document minimum resolutions where relevant.
security: Kiosk deployments need hardening: disable escape hatches where required
Run with least privilege on shared or public devices
